description: Requests an introduction to a candidate returned by search_candidates. The request goes to the Hire Overseas team, who verify the candidate, confirm availability and pricing, and reply to the contact email, usually within one business day. Requires the requester's real company name and work email. One request covers one candidate. The answer can include an intro video link, which may identify the person.

clientContact.description: The user's work email, where Hire Overseas replies

lead_token.description: Optional. The leadToken from verify_email, once the user has verified their work email. Unlocks the candidate's anonymized Hire Overseas résumé text and candidate page (branded résumé and intro video) and uses the verified email.

message.description: Optional note for the Hire Overseas team: start date, hours, budget or anything else about the role

roleTitle.description: Job title the candidate is being considered for, e.g. 'Bookkeeper'

name: request_intro
title: Request an introduction to a candidate
